q1_issues.issue: (For sk_ways_1 sk_end_1) uses a head that is not the surface word — "ways TO end world hunger" has an infinitival "to", and the instruction set forbids a synonym head for a near-fit reading (the "vehicle for" example carries head For because "for" is what the text says).
Same head substitution for the second conjunct: (For sk_ways_1 sk_end_2).

q2_gaps: a noun with a to-infinitival complement ("ways to end world hunger") — the noun-complement section covers of-phrases and prepositional arguments on nominalizations, and the purpose-infinitive head To is defined only between two EVENTS, so nothing licenses an infinitival complement hanging off a noun's own symbol

a bare indefinite plural in object position that carries its own modifier ("discuss ways to …") — the rules reserve the bare class symbol for non-specific objects and mint group witnesses for definite/counted plurals, leaving no settled form for this case
notes: Otherwise clean: the passive by-phrase correctly takes Agent, the multi-word name us_department_of_agriculture keeps its internal lowercase particle with the kind stated in a separate type atom, the purpose infinitive is (To sk_sponsor_1 sk_discuss_1) with the embedded events correctly tenseless, the coordinated object distributes into two end events, and (Inheritance world_hunger hunger) correctly withholds a genus for the noun modifier.
